bounds.apps/cli/main.go: Only replace doctor switch body with cliDoctor and remove imports made unused. Other verbs unchanged.
bounds.apps/cli/cli_doctor.go: One read-only diagnostic path: discovery and bounded local health request, existing local credential retrieval, strict typed authenticated host.status, allowlisted sanitized rendering and exit mapping. No domain/API/session/config/model mutations.
bounds.apps/cli/cli_doctor_test.go: Five proposed focused test groups plus necessary native built-CLI/real local typed-service controls, isolated temporary state, secret sentinels, no provider calls.
bounds.tests/runtime/cli_contract/v2verbs.go: Only add a host.status-specific valid CommandResponse/HostStatusResult within the successful complete/strict branch, before generic placeholder. Echo actual command/client IDs and method. Keep all prior assertions and exit expectations byte-identical; retain unhealthy/rejected/notimplemented/inprogress/malformed branches and other method handlers.

mandatory_behavior: Discovery absent/invalid JSON remains exit3 with NOT_FOUND/INVALID_JSON. Connection failure/health DOWN remains exit1; HTTP503 retained in http_code. Invalid local URL/input exit2. stdout exactly one JSON record; sanitized diagnostics only on stderr.

Health requests must not reuse hostGet without overriding redirect behavior: existing hostGet follows redirects. Implement bounded no-redirect local health request in cli_doctor.go; validate local loopback URL before any credential or HTTP use, reject userinfo/query/fragment and remote targets.

Build fresh host-level context with empty cliConfig and no project/session/writer args. Reuse only explicit CLI bearer or existing session credential helper; no cliInitCredential renewal branch, host launch, chooser, writer claim or persistent config write.

Use v2CallContext strict protocol/command_id/method checks, then frozen CommandResponse and HostStatusResult schema checks and echoed client_id equality. Require COMPLETED; ACKNOWLEDGED/IN_PROGRESS/malformed/extra-field/identity-substitution replies cannot complete doctor.

Map missing/expired credential and actual authorization/resource blocks to exit3. Protocol/transport/check failure exit1. A healthy endpoint with HTTP503 on command is a failed check, not evidence of successful auth. Do not reuse transport helper exit3 for every non-2xx blindly.

Host health UP and READY, supported_methods, model IDs, AVAILABLE credential status or historical verified_at cannot establish provider usability. Emit provider_verification=NOT_CHECKED, provider_network_called=false and tool_qualification=NOT_EVALUATED.

Current API leaves ModelConfigs/CredentialSumm/WorkspaceBind unpopulated. Empty arrays mean NOT_REPORTED_BY_HOST (or equivalent explicit host-unreported diagnostic), never machine-wide NOT_CONFIGURED/no credentials. Do not invent model inventory or read private stores to fill it.

Allowlist bounded identifiers/counts and explicit diagnostic codes only. Do not serialize raw reply/error/probe text, credential_ref, principal data, raw provider URL or bearer. Redact known credential from every retained string, including discovery/detail/path fields; malformed inputs may themselves contain a sentinel.
Exit0 means local diagnostic report obtained. Preserve all original UP0/DOWN1/NOTFOUND3/discovery override assertions. No W05/A04/provider/agent task success inference.

test_completion_gates.name: TestW05DoctorDiscoveryAndDownCompatibility
checks: Missing discovery => NOT_FOUND/REJECTED/exit3; invalid discovery JSON => INVALID_JSON/exit3
Closed loopback host and health503 => health DOWN/REJECTED/exit1; preserve http_code503
stdout exactly one JSON object; stderr contains only sanitized diagnostics; no POST after failed health

test_completion_gates.name: TestW05DoctorTypedHostStatus
checks: Actual native CLI process against recording loopback HTTP server sends one GET healthz and exactly one authenticated POST v2/command, method host.status, empty payload
No session/project/writer claim is sent, even with a saved stale session; command/client/reply identity match
Valid CommandResponse + HostStatusResult produces exit0 and allowlisted host/capability/model diagnostic facts; missing model inventory remains explicitly unreported
REJECTED/auth401 => exit3; incomplete/pending status, wrong identity, malformed or schema-invalid result => nonzero, never health-only success

test_completion_gates.name: TestW05DoctorSecretsAndNoProviderCalls
checks: Known bearer sentinel and malicious raw health/error bodies never appear in stdout/stderr
Do not echo credential_ref, base_url credentials/query, session token, or arbitrary raw response/error text
Capture all requests; provider.probe/provider.models/host.configure/session.* never called; redirect not followed; no provider external address visited
Credential AVAILABLE, verified_at, supported_methods and health READY never produce provider_usable=true or tool-qualified claims; provider_verification=NOT_CHECKED

test_completion_gates.name: TestW05DoctorLocalHostIntegration
checks: Fresh temporary SQLite + real existing API handler/local host supplies real typed host.status to built CLI, local session auth through existing helper
No existing user DB, model profile, protected holdout or external provider read/call; no workspace chooser or configuration mutation
Real service empty model_configurations/credentials reported as NOT_REPORTED_BY_HOST, without asserting systemwide absence

test_completion_gates.name: TestW05DoctorCredentialBlockAndContextPreservation
checks: Absent/expired local auth => exit3 without fake UP completion; no token printed
Read config/session fixture bytes unchanged, no new writer epoch/session created, no automatic host launch/bootstrap/configure
Native CLI invocation runs under a path containing Chinese characters/spaces; recorded argv/exit/raw and binary hash retained

additional_test_requirements: Run focused TestW05Doctor tests, complete apps/cli regression, native built executable with recorded binary hash/argv/raw/exits, and original cli_contract harness under an exclusive receipt namespace. Inspect harness fixed output paths before running; retain every original failure.

Verify HTTP503/DOWN, absent discovery, malformed health/status, 401/expired credential, wrong method/command/client, nonterminal reply, redirect and remote URL refusals, secret sentinels, saved session unchanged, real fresh local API/SQLite empty inventory.
Do not edit apps/cli/build_check.py A7; verify actual local credential availability or retain a real block instead of weakening its assertions.

applicability.basis: Independent exact vector and coverage checks against actual bound contexts; not a blanket future exemption.
